profile.headline: UI & Workflow Manager at Ross Video
profile.summary:
SOFTWARE ENGINEER / APPLICATION DEVELOPER

Over 15 years of software engineering experience for commercial applications. Strong skills in user interface and application design, implementation, and product development; including five years of project leadership. Also includes several years of embedded systems and real-time programming with extensive Microsoft® and Linux® application development experience. Other strengths include excellent problem solving skills, debugging, attention to detail, and ability to adapt to support team and customer needs.

Specialties: Visual Golang, Javascript, Node JS, HTML, C++, C/C++, C# .NET, Design Patterns, Linux 2.6, Fedora 12, Eclipse, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), Component Object Mode (COM/DCOM), ActiveX, Standard Template Library (STL), Microsoft Visio, Microsoft SourceSafe, Concurrent Version System (CVS), SmartCVS, SQL Server
